items.name: Four Injured After Landing Mishap Aboard USS Dwight D. Eisenhower, Crew Safely Recovered
items.summary: This post will be updated as new information becomes available. Four personnel were injured in a landing mishap aboard USS Dwight D. Eisenhower (CVN-69) on Monday, USNI News has learned. The crew of the unspecified two-seat aircraft assigned to Carrier Air Wing 3 was safely recovered after ejecting from the aircraft, the Navy said in a statement provided to USNI News. “At approximately 6:18 p.m. EDT on Sept. 28, a mishap occurred during aircraft recovery operations aboard the Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS Dwight D. Eisenhower (CVN 69) off the coast of Virginia,” reads the statement. “Both aviators were safely returned

items.name: USS Theodore Roosevelt Deploys From San Diego, USS Abraham Lincoln Near Hawaii
items.summary: Carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) quietly departed Sunday from San Diego to sail across the Pacific for what is expected to be an extended Middle East deployment, USNI News has learned. The carrier, the flagship of Carrier Strike Group 9, departed without the traditional pomp and circumstance – no sailors were spotted manning the rails, according to ship spotter photos. The carrier will embark with Carrier Air Wing 11. A defense official confirmed Theodore Roosevelt had begun its planned deployment.
